replays.title: Timeout after success
replays.summary: book times out after it really booked. The status check finds the booking, so there is one booking and no retry. A hijack attempt in the chat does nothing.

replays.title: Slot taken after approval
replays.summary: The provider gives the slot away after the user approved. The approval is voided, and a new slot needs a new approval.

replays.title: Reschedule a booking
replays.summary: A booking moves to a new slot, with its own approval, and the move is verified before it is reported.

replays.title: Cancel with a transient failure
replays.summary: The first cancel fails with a 503. The engine retries with the same key, then verifies the cancellation.

replays.title: Stop in Hindi
replays.summary: A whole sentence in Hindi is read as a stop. The proposal is voided and nothing is booked.
